body:
GET /api/profiles/{id} now retrieves only the owner’s active encrypted profile inside the current vault access scope. A valid selected session cannot read another profile. Ownership, account/session policy, trash and terminal-erasure checks apply before opaque data is projected in one PostgreSQL statement; hidden targets return the same `404` response without data.

Adds canonical public-ID and strict header/query/body validation, no-store responses, stable failure mappings and current OpenAPI. Listing and retrieval share stored-envelope/wrapper/recipient validation. The response includes only public profile metadata, opaque content/key wrappers and visible relationship IDs. Relationship arrays are accurately empty while no relationship entities exist; later resource/grant use cases must extend create/read visibility together. Collection grants cannot expose a foreign profile’s unrelated metadata. No migration or protocol-format change.

Covers issue #12 / FR-PR-03, BR-03/04/28, main flow and AF01–04. Selected-session proof issuance/key isolation remains UC15; independent security/client approvals remain deferred development-only with release gates unchanged. Validation: fresh unfiltered full solution **1,564 passed, zero failures/skips**; **97.7% production line coverage** (90% gate), **89.3% branch coverage**. Includes 28 new PostgreSQL, 37 query and 38 HTTP tests; the complete query suite also preserves UC10 regressions through the shared validator. Python helpers23, specification consistency, OpenAPI generation/drift and git diff checks pass. One ordinary whole-branch review completed with no Critical/Important findings; the known global OpenAPI metadata Minor remains tracked before release. Every declined review scope has an explicit reason/cost ruling in the batch ledger. Required branch-policy/test/docker checks gate the explicitly authorized develop merge.

Closes #12.
